title: lathyrus sylvestris subsp. pyrenaicus
intro: Lathyrus sylvestris subsp. pyrenaicus, commonly known as the Pyrenean vetchling, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus sylvestris subsp. pyrenaicus include its ability to act as a vasodilator, improving blood flow and lowering blood pressure, as well as its potential to exert antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
